TacticalIdentity: Battlefield architect that wins by building a network of Crystal Nodes, Prisms, and Walls — storing ally elemental spells in Nodes and releasing them as second-strike AoE bursts. Crystal Prisms redirect beam and projectile spells 90 degrees around cover. Lowest direct damage in the roster; power scales entirely with ally coordination and construct survivability.

Spells.Description: A single crystal projectile that travels in a line and bounces off Crystal Prisms in its path. Deals physical damage and can reach targets around corners when Prisms are positioned correctly.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: BRITTLE_ARMOR triggers on Crystal Shard impact (+50% damage)
Crystal resonates with sonic resonance — deals 20 total damage on RESONATING tile

TerrainChanges.Description: Ice-shard fragments deal 5 cold splash to adjacent units on ICE_TILE impact

Spells.Description: Deploys a Crystal Node (stores elemental energy), Crystal Prism (redirects beam/projectile spells 90 degrees), or Crystal Wall (3-tile movement barrier) on a target tile. Maximum 3 total constructs active; placing a 4th shatters the oldest.

AppliedEffects.Description: Deploys chosen construct type (Node/Prism/Wall). Crystal Node: 15 HP, stores last elemental spell that hits it. Crystal Prism: 15 HP, refracts beam/line spells 90 degrees. Crystal Wall: 3-tile line, 20 HP/tile, blocks movement. Constructs shatter for 10 AoE on destruction.

TerrainChanges.Description: Places crystal construct on target tile

Spells.Description: Triggers a charged Crystal Node within range, releasing its stored elemental spell as a 2-tile AoE burst at 70% of the original spell's base damage. The element, terrain interactions, and secondary effects all match the stored spell. Destroys the Node on use.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: RESONATING tile amplifies release to 85% of original spell damage (up from 70%)
CHARGED terrain adds 12 Lightning damage to the release burst
Unstable Node (1-14 HP) adds 15 explosive shrapnel damage in 1-tile radius

AppliedEffects.Description: Releases stored element as 2-tile AoE at 70% base damage. Secondary effects at 70% application probability. Node consumed on release.

TerrainChanges.Description: Terrain changes match the stored element's standard interactions

Spells.Description: Crystal energy cascades through the Crystalomancer's network starting at the targeted construct, chaining to all other constructs within 3 tiles. Each construct pulses a 1-tile AoE (20 at first, 15 at each subsequent). Participating constructs gain +10 HP from energy reinforcement. Charged Nodes release 20% of stored element alongside the pulse.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: RESONATING tile doubles the cascade pulse damage at that construct (30 HP instead of 15)
CHARGED tile adds 10 Lightning arc discharge chaining to adjacent WET units

AppliedEffects.Description: Cascade chains construct-to-construct within 3 tiles. 20 HP at primary, 15 HP at each subsequent. Each construct gains +10 HP from energy surge. Nodes release 20% stored charge alongside pulse.

Spells.Description: The Crystalomancer generates a Grand Prism Array, auto-placing 6 Crystal Prisms at equidistant points around itself in a 4-tile radius. For 3 turns, any beam or line spell entering the array bounces between Prisms, gaining +10% of original base damage per bounce (max 3 bounces = +30%). The Array collapses after 3 turns, all 6 Prisms shattering simultaneously for 10 HP AoE each. Crystalomancer cannot move this turn.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: Each bounce through Array Prisms adds +10% of original spell base damage (up to 3 bounces)

AppliedEffects.Description: Spawns 6 Grand Prisms in 4-tile radius around caster. Array persists 3 turns. All 6 Prisms override existing construct limit (oldest 3 standard constructs collapse). Array Prisms immune to destruction for 3-turn duration. All 6 shatter simultaneously on expiry.
